oracle: The deterministic heuristic that runs BEFORE the layer: a negation marker in the turn text means 'negation', otherwise 'continuation'. Each case records that outcome as `deterministicRelation`.
honesty: Replay accuracy against this oracle is 100% BY CONSTRUCTION and therefore NOT a measure of model quality: resolveWithDecision returns the deterministic value on every path, so the number proves the layer cannot change an outcome, nothing more. What the replay does measure is (a) advisory agreement/disagreement, (b) fallback rates (threshold, abstention, unavailability) and (c) that the request never carries user content. Accuracy, calibration, latency and cost against a REAL provider remain PENDING configuration — the layer is default-off, there is no credential in the repo and no `AI` binding deployed. No such number is invented here.

dimensions.note: `category_ranking`, `subcategory_ranking` and `intent_routing` are uses the issue lists but NOT operations this repo implements. They are declared pending rather than simulated here: the closed `DECISION_ALLOWED_OPERATIONS` enum contains only `continuation_relation`, and a case that claimed to cover them would be measuring nothing.

realProvider.blockedBy: Default-off by design (issue #86): no credential provisioned, no AI binding added, no local Strands deployment.
realProvider.command: pnpm --filter pi-finance-agent exec vitest run tests/evals/decision-dataset.test.ts
